status: Exploratory after the frozen primary scores. Signed before evaluating the direction-aware controls. Direction-aware results cannot alter the original fitted models, comparisons or decision gates.
motivation: A participant walks back and forth on the ten-metre walkway. A phase mean in fixed laboratory X and Y may cancel forwards and return traverses. The previous repeat can proceed in the opposite laboratory direction.
heading: For each cutoff, sum the available within-token X movements of both anterior pelvic landmarks over the eight history tokens. Negative sum -> multiply all X and Y components of every pelvic-relative marker position and within-token movement by -1, and the displacements by -1 in X and Y; retain Z and left/right anatomical labels. Sum zero -> use +1 and count. Reverse the same transform on the forecast. No target or future frame sets the direction.
phase: Refit the identical frozen training event-and-elapsed-time weighted averages in heading-aligned displacement coordinates. Convert back to laboratory axes using the query heading. No current-trial future event or target is used.
personal: Recalculate per-feature mean and scale on heading-aligned TRAINING tokens only, reusing the same walker/trial/window weights, missingness and scale floor. Match the last two aligned standardized marker tokens to the three nearest histories in the immediately previous completed repeat from that same person; same inverse-distance weights, observed donor targets first rotated by donor heading. Transform prediction back by query sign. Report the identical later-repeat subset.
scores: Original participant-macro 3D Euclidean errors, paired walker bootstrap 95% intervals using original seed and reported paired contrasts to combined Transformer. Stratify repetition pairs by whether estimated source and target trial headings (majority sign) match. Counts are cutoffs; strata descriptive. No new confirmatory thresholds.
